questions.question: Apply: Project pitch ko senior level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Project pitch: short narrative that connects problem, solution, stack, evidence and your contribution. Example: 60-90 sec structured pitch. Pitfall: listing tools only.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: resume/interview credibility ke liye.

questions.question: Compare: Architecture defense ko senior level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Architecture defense: explain boundaries, data flow, components, failure paths and trade-offs. Example: request -> service -> DB -> model -> response. Pitfall: diagram without runtime behavior.

questions.question: Choose: Debugging defense ko senior level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Debugging defense: explain how you reproduced, isolated, fixed and regression-tested a failure. Example: reproduce -> inspect -> isolate -> fix -> test. Pitfall: guessing root cause.

questions.question: Diagnose: Trade-offs ko senior level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.

questions.question: Justify: Scaling ko senior level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Scaling: design ko higher traffic/data/latency constraints ke liye adapt karna. Example: cache, batch, queue, horizontal scale. Pitfall: scaling before measuring bottleneck.

questions.question: Design: Next improvements ko senior level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.

def pct(xs, p):
    ordered = sorted(xs)
    k = (len(ordered) - 1) * p / 100
    lo, hi = int(k), min(int(k) + 1, len(ordered) - 1)
    return round(ordered[lo] + (ordered[hi] - ordered[lo]) * (k - lo), 1)
print('p50:', pct(latencies, 50), 'p95:', pct(latencies, 95), 'max:', max(latencies))
print('p50 [80]:', pct([80], 50), 'p95 empty guard:', pct([1, 2], 0))

questions.question: API timeout ho raha hai sirf peak hours me. Debug plan?
questions.answer: Percentile latency + pool/queue metrics ko time ke saath correlate karo, DB slow queries aur connection wait time dekho, aur autoscaling rules check karo. Fix: pool tuning + cache + horizontal scale.
questions.explanation: Time-correlated metrics.

questions.question: Frontend me API response parse ho raha hai kabhi-kabhi fail. Root cause?
questions.answer: Response shape mismatch (error case me different schema) ya streaming/partial response. Fix: contract define karo, error shape same rakho, aur client par schema validation (zod/pydantic-like) lagao.
questions.explanation: Error shape bhi contract hai.

questions.question: Password reset email production me nahi aa rahe. Layers kaise check karoge?
questions.answer: Send API response/logs (provider accepted?), queue/worker running, template/config, aur spam folder. Silent catch ko remove karo — har stage ka log likho.
questions.explanation: Stage-wise logging.

questions.question: Rolling deploy ke baad 5% requests fail ho rahe hain. Hypothesis?
questions.answer: Mixed versions (old/new) with incompatible API/DB schema — expand-contract migration chahiye. Check: failing requests kis version par gayi (logs me version tag hona chahiye).
questions.explanation: Version tag logs me rakho.

questions.question: Docker build cache har baar invalidate ho raha hai (slow builds). Fix?
questions.answer: COPY order theek karo (requirements pehle, code baad me), .dockerignore me node_modules/.git, aur layer me changing files (version stamps) alag rakho. Build time halve ho jaata hai.
questions.explanation: Requirements pehle copy karo.

questions.question: Eval script local par chalta hai, CI me nahi (different numbers). Wajah?
questions.answer: Random seeds, data version, library versions, ya test order. Fix: seeds pin karo, eval data ko repo/artifact me version karo, aur deterministic ordering.
questions.explanation: Seeds + data versioning.

questions.question: Model inference time production me 3x hai local se. Kya check karoge?
questions.answer: CPU vs GPU, thread/BLAS config, batch size (1 vs batched), quantization/ONNX runtime differences, aur container CPU limits (throttling). cgroup throttling aam wajah hai.
questions.explanation: Runtime + limits + batching.

questions.question: Project me feature flag add kiya, par flag hamesha default hi le raha hai. Bug?
questions.answer: Evaluation key missing (user id), SDK cache stale, ya wrong environment/config loaded. Fix: flag evaluation log karo (kaunsa key, kaunsa value) aur default intentionally rakho.
questions.explanation: Flag evaluation log karo.

questions.question: Production me data pipeline ne kuch rows drop kar diye (silent). Fix kaise permanent karoge?
questions.answer: Row count assertions per stage (input vs output + expected), drop reasons count karo (null/parse/skip), aur alert on delta. Silent drop sabse khatarnak bug hai — count-based monitoring hi solution hai.
questions.explanation: Counts + drop reasons.

questions.question: Local me tests pass hote hain, CI me flaky. Sabse common wajah?
questions.answer: Time/timezone, shared state between tests, order dependence, network/timeouts, aur unseeded randomness. Fix: fixtures isolate karo, freezegun/frozen time, aur retries nahi — root cause.
questions.explanation: Isolation + frozen time.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Tumhare system ka architecture 60 second me explain karo.'
questions.answer: Client → API (FastAPI, containerized, N replicas) → Postgres (private) + Redis cache; background jobs queue par; retrieval service with vector index; logs/metrics/traces centralized. Deploy CI/CD se, aur ek diagram hai.
questions.explanation: Boxes + data flow + ops.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Sabse mushkil technical decision kaunsa tha?'
questions.answer: Chunking + retrieval strategy (naive fixed-size se recall low tha). Options evaluate kiye (semantic, table-aware, hybrid + RRF), eval set par measure kiya, aur table-aware + hybrid chuna: recall@5 0.62 → 0.86.
questions.explanation: Options + measurement + decision.

questions.question: Project defense: 'System kitna scale karega?'
questions.answer: Currently ~20 rps p95 400ms par single service + shared DB; bottleneck DB connections aur vector index latency hai. Scale plan: read replicas, cache warming, service horizontal scaling, aur index sharding. Numbers + plan.
questions.explanation: Current + bottleneck + plan.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Aapki accuracy ka confidence kya hai — kya dataset chhota nahi tha?'
questions.answer: Eval set 180 cases (production sampling se), per-bucket breakdown ke saath; confidence interval wide hai small buckets par, isliye wahan 'insufficient data' report karte hain — overclaiming nahi.
questions.explanation: Buckets + honest CI.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Kya tumne cost-per-user measure kiya?'
questions.answer: Haan: ~$0.02 per task (2.4k tokens avg), aur cache hit rate 42% ke saath ~$0.011 effective. Cost dashboard live hai aur budget alert lagaya hai.
questions.explanation: Per-user cost + cache effect.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Failure par system ka behaviour kya hai?'
questions.answer: Degraded modes defined: retrieval down → 'search unavailable' with retry, model down → fallback provider ya rules-only path, DB slow → cached response. Har mode user-facing message ke saath tested hai.
questions.explanation: Degraded modes + messages.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Testing strategy batao (project level).'
questions.answer: Unit tests for pure logic, integration tests for API + DB (containerized), contract tests for schemas, eval regression nightly, aur post-deploy smoke test. CI me gate, aur coverage critical paths par focus.
questions.explanation: Layers + gates.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Data privacy kaise handle ki?'
questions.answer: PII redaction before prompts, logs me masked fields, retention policy short for raw text, aur user delete path (memory + traces). Legal/simple: minimize data, don't log content.
questions.explanation: Redact + minimize + delete path.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: production me model badalna ho to kya karoge?'
questions.answer: Shadow mode me naye model ko production traffic par chalao, offline eval + shadow metrics compare, canary 5% rollout with quality/latency/cost gates, phir full. Rollback ek config change.
questions.explanation: Shadow → canary → gated rollout.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Aapke project me kaunsi cheez tumhare control me nahi thi?'
questions.answer: Upstream data quality aur third-party API availability. Isliye schema assertions, retries with backoff, fallback data source, aur degraded mode implement kiya — dependency failure ko predictable banaya.
questions.explanation: External risk + mitigation.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Monitoring se tumhe kaunsa real issue mila?'
questions.answer: Latency alert ne dikhaya ki ek query ne pool exhaust kiya — fix: index + statement timeout, aur alert actionable ho gaya. Story format: symptom → measurement → fix → verification.
questions.explanation: Alert → fix story.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Agar 10x data aata to pipeline kaunsa part pehla tootega?'
questions.answer: Vector index build time aur in-memory aggregation. Plan: incremental/indexed build, sharded retrieval, pre-aggregated tables, aur chunked processing with out-of-core engine (DuckDB/polars).
questions.explanation: Bottleneck + plan.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Sabse bada trade-off jo tumne consciously liya?'
questions.answer: Freshness vs cost: nightly index refresh chuna (realtime embedding costly tha) aur freshness SLA UI me dikhaya ('data as of'). Explicit trade-off + mitigation (on-demand reindex path).
questions.explanation: Trade-off + mitigation.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Aapne kya automate kiya aur kitna time bacha?'
questions.answer: Manual data cleanup + weekly report ko scheduled pipeline me convert kiya: 3-4 ghante/week manual work → 2 minute job, aur numbers consistent. Time saved measurable hai.
questions.explanation: Automation + measured time.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: is project me tumhara contribution kya tha (team project ho to)?'
questions.answer: Ownership explicitly bolo: 'maine retrieval + eval pipeline banaya, X ne frontend' — aur integration contract kisne define kiya. Team project me ambiguity sabse bura signal hai.
questions.explanation: Ownership crystal clear.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Kya tum ise dobara banate to kya alag karte?'
questions.answer: Pehle eval set aur baseline banata (main ne baad me banaya, isliye kuch decisions measurement ke bina liye). Aur logging structured shuru se — debugging time bahut bachta.
questions.explanation: Honest hindsight + reason.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Aapka system kis problem ko solve karta hai aur kiska nahi?'
questions.answer: Solves: docs/order/policy ke grounded answers with citations. Doesn't solve: real-time data (freshness lag), open-ended advice, aur high-stakes financial decisions — scope boundaries clearly bolna maturity dikhata hai.
questions.explanation: Scope + non-scope.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Security posture kya hai?'
questions.answer: Auth via JWT with short TTL + refresh, per-tenant data isolation with enforced filters, input validation + size limits, rate limiting, secrets in manager, dependency scanning in CI. Known gap: no WAF, documented.
questions.explanation: Posture + known gap.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: mujhe 3 numbers do jo tumhara kaam prove karte hain.'
questions.answer: 1) recall@5 0.62 → 0.86 (chunking + hybrid retrieval). 2) p95 latency 1.4s → 400ms (rerank + cache + prompt trim). 3) Cost per task $0.041 → $0.019 (cascade + caching).
questions.explanation: Teen numbers, teen lever.

questions.question: Project defense: 'Interviewer: dependency failure par system kya karta hai — demo karo.'

questions.explanation: Demo-able resilience.

questions.question: Interview me tumne kaha "p50 latency 120ms, p95 360ms" — interviewer isse kya samajh raha hai?
questions.answer: Ki 1 in 20 request 360ms tak jaati hai, isliye average ke bajaye tail experience describe ho raha hai. Numbers ke saath source bhi batao (kitne requests, kis load par) — warna interviewer impressionistic samjhega.

questions.question: Apne resume project ka 60-second answer ka structure likho.
questions.answer: (1) Problem + scale (users/rows/latency), (2) meri role aur constraints, (3) approach + ek explicit tradeoff, (4) result ek number me, (5) ek bug/lesson aur next improvement. Har step 10-15 sec — interviewer interruption ke liye jagah bachao.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Resume project ke follow-up question par atak gaye — sabse likely reason?
questions.answer: Numbers aur decisions yaad nahi (kitne rows, kyun wo chunk size, kya index lagaya). Fix: ek 'metrics card' yaad rakho — scale, latency, accuracy, cost — aur har number ka source bata sako (kahan measure kiya, kaunsa tool).
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Kaun sa edge case demo/interview me project claim ko todta hai?
questions.answer: Reproduce na ho paana (data/branch/environment alag) aur claim ka number already stale hona. Fix: seeded sample data, README me exact run steps, aur wahi branch/commit demo karo jiska number bata rahe ho — ya claim ko 'jis data par measure kiya wo ye tha' likh kar bound karo.
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Project architecture samjhate waqt pehle kya rakho — framework list ya data flow?

questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Interviewer "isko kaise improve karoge" pooche — pehle kya bologe?
questions.answer: Ek measured bottleneck bolo (p95 latency / cost per 1k calls / accuracy gap) aur uska specific fix (caching, batch size, index, quantization) — impact aur effort dono estimate karke. "Sab kuch better karunga" ya tool-stack badalna weak lagta hai kyunki problem statement hi nahi hota.
